consequence.statement: Existing NodePool objects remain stored as v1beta1 until rewritten; a storage version migration must re-write all objects and update status.storedVersions before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all NodePool objects (storage version migration) and update status.storedVersions.

original.statement: The NodePool CRD (nodepools.karpenter.sh) storage version changes from v1beta1 to v1, so existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 until a storage version migration rewrites them and status.storedVersions is updated before a later release removes v1beta1.

consequence.statement: Existing NodePool objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten and keep working in this release. If they are not rewritten and status.storedVersions is not updated, a later release that removes v1beta1 will be affected.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading to a release that removes v1beta1, rewrite all NodePool objects (storage version migration) so they are stored as v1, and remove v1beta1 from status.storedVersions of the nodepools.karpenter.sh CRD.

corrected.statement: The storage version of nodepools.karpenter.sh changes from v1beta1 to v1. Existing NodePool objects stay stored as v1beta1 and keep working. They must be rewritten and status.storedVersions updated before a later release removes v1beta1.

decision.reason: The validators confirm from the CRD artifacts [ev-760ae3491f13] [ev-09bbe26d2f4a] that the nodepools.karpenter.sh storage version moves from v1beta1 to v1. The change text says existing objects simply stay stored as v1beta1 and the rewrite is needed only before a later release removes v1beta1. Nothing in this release is said to fail, be rejected or stop being honoured, and the evidence excerpts are empty. That fits deprecation (works today, breaks in a later release), not migration-required for this upgrade.
